root_causes: 3 unresolved torch ABI symbols in _C.abi3.so and _rocm_C.abi3.so, including torch::Library::_def() variants
Native extension import fails with undefined symbol _ZNR5torch7Library4_defEON3c1014FunctionSchemaEPNS1_12OperatorNameERKSt6vectorINS_10headeronly3TagESaIS8_EENS_17_RegisterOrVerifyE
vLLM server crashes (HTTP 500) on all inference requests due to native extension loading failure
summary.recommended_action: Rebuild vLLM 0.25.2.dev0 native extensions against PyTorch 2.11.0+rocm7.15.0a20260724 using ROCm 7.15.0, ensuring the wheel's compiled _C.abi3.so and _rocm_C.abi3.so match the linked torch library ABI.
